title: 2A1 has been rebuilt
body:
The 2A1 paper has been rebuilt from the current edition of the book. Diagrams and step-by-step visuals run through every chapter, and there are new lessons on projectile motion and buoyancy.

If you're working on 2A1, your progress carried over. A few objectives in chapters 1, 2, 8 and 12 were renumbered to match the new edition, and any lesson you'd started picks up at the beginning of that objective.
